_note: Try-on hat forms (target ~15). width = longest model side in cm (size it so the crown fits a ~20x15.5 cm head); yaw = radians to turn the model so its long axis points front-back; offset = [x,y,z] cm of the model's lowest point from MediaPipe face origin (y up, z toward camera); tilt = radians, positive tips the hat forward (front brim down). Add ?debug to the URL to see the head occluder.
